Offer IMS features on carriers that have not certified them for this device
Advertise VoLTE, Wi\u2011Fi calling, video calling and 5G as available, and skip carrier provisioning. The modem restarts when this is changed.
Insert a SIM to configure IMS features.

These settings override what your carrier publishes for this device. Features may not work, or may work unreliably, on a network that has not been tested with this hardware. Turn a switch off to restore your carrier\'s own configuration.

Forcing these features changes how emergency calls are placed and how your location is shared with emergency services.

On an untested network an emergency call may fail to connect, may be routed to the wrong centre, or may not carry your location. Your carrier has not certified this device for these features.

If you rely on this phone for emergency calls, leave this off.
Make the modem pick its carrier configuration again. Changing a switch above already does this; use it after an update adds configurations for your carrier.
Your mobile network will disconnect for a few seconds. Any call in progress will be dropped.
This modem does not support restarting. Reboot to apply.
